Вопрос: Choose the correct possessive adjective: "This is ___ brother."
Объяснение: We use "my" before nouns to show possession. "Mine" is used without a noun (e.g. "This book is mine").

Вопрос: Complete the sentence: "My sister ___ a teacher."
Объяснение: We use "is" with he/she/it (third person singular). "My sister" = she so we use "is".

Вопрос: Choose the correct form: "I ___ two brothers."
Объяснение: We use "have" with I/you/we/they. "Has" is used only with he/she/it.

Вопрос: Read the text: "Hi! My name is Anna. I have a big family. My mother's name is Lisa. She is 45 years old. My father is Tom. He is 48. I have one sister. Her name is Kate." How old is Anna's mother?
Объяснение: The text says "My mother's name is Lisa. She is 45 years old."

Вопрос: Read: "My best friend is Mike. He is 25 years old. He is from Canada. Mike is tall and has brown hair. He likes sports and music." Where is Mike from?
Объяснение: The text clearly states "He is from Canada."

Вопрос: Read the dialogue: "Tom: Do you have any brothers or sisters? Sarah: Yes I have one brother. Tom: What's his name? Sarah: His name is John. He is 20 years old." How many siblings does Sarah have?
Варианты ответов: One brother | Two brothers | One sister | No siblings
Объяснение: Sarah says "I have one brother" - so she has only one sibling.

Вопрос: What do you call your mother's mother?
Объяснение: Your mother's mother (or father's mother) is your grandmother. You can also say "grandma" or "granny".

Вопрос: Choose the correct word: My friend is very ___. She always makes me laugh.
Объяснение: Funny means someone who makes you laugh. If someone "makes me laugh" they are funny.

Вопрос: What do you call your father's brother?
Объяснение: Your father's brother (or mother's brother) is your uncle. His wife is your aunt and their children are your cousins.

Вопрос: Your friend asks: "Do you have any brothers or sisters?" You have one sister. What do you say?
Варианты ответов: Yes I have one sister. | Yes I have sister. | Yes I am one sister. | Yes I has one sister.
Объяснение: We say "I have one sister" (with "one" before the noun). "I have sister" is incorrect - we need an article or number.

Вопрос: You want to introduce your mother to your friend. What do you say?
Варианты ответов: This is my mother. | She is my mother. | This my mother. | That my mother is.
Объяснение: When introducing someone we use "This is..." (for people near you). "This is my mother" is the natural way to introduce family members.

Вопрос: Your friend asks about your family. You want to say you live with your parents. What is correct?
Варианты ответов: I live with my parents. | I live with my parent. | I am live with my parents. | I living with my parents.
Объяснение: I live with my parents" is the correct form. "Parents" is plural (mother and father together). We don't use "am" or "-ing" with "live" in this case.

Варианты ответов: My sister is kind. | I have two brother. | This is my friend Kate. | She name is Anna.
Объяснение: Correct: "My sister is kind". Wrong: "I have two brother" (should be "brothers") "She name is Anna" (should be "Her name is Anna").

Вопрос: Complete the text with the correct words: "This is ___ family. ___ mother is a doctor. I ___ one brother."
Варианты ответов: my / My / have | my / My / has | mine / My / have | my / Mine / have
Объяснение: This is MY family" (possessive) "MY mother" (capital at start of sentence) "I HAVE" (correct form of have).

Вопрос: Write 3-4 sentences about your family or a friend. Include: who they are their age or job and one thing you like about them.
Правильный ответ: Example: I have a big family. My mother is 45 years old. She is very kind. I also have a best friend. His name is Tom. He is funny and friendly.
Объяснение: Good answer should include family members or friends some details (age/job/appearance) and personal opinion. Use simple present tense and possessive adjectives correctly.
